content:
[L] high | first row (Job failure) | body text is truncated mid-sentence ending with "check that LM St…" with no ellipsis affordance or expansion control visible.
[L] high | bottom row (Mention, 3d ago) | the last card is clipped at the window edge, its body text cut in half by the viewport with no visible scroll region boundary.
[L] med | "7 total: 3 unread" header row | the count label collides with/nearly touches the window title text "Notifications" at the very top edge, both cramped against the frame.
[S] med | row heights across list | cards have inconsistent vertical heights (Job failure ~110px, Sync failure ~95px, SLA breach ~100px) producing uneven rhythm and ragged card bottoms.
[S] med | first row badge dot | the unread dot in row 1 is vertically offset and nearly touching the "Job failure" badge, unlike the aligned dots/badges in other rows.
[S] med | top header area | "Mark All Read" sits at the far right with different padding than the per-row "Mark Read" actions, and the header strip has no consistent inset from the window edge.
[S] low | timestamps | timestamps ("just now", "Yesterday", "2d ago") sit at inconsistent x-offsets because they trail badges of differing widths instead of aligning to a shared column.
[H] med | row titles vs body | unread and read rows use nearly identical text weight; read rows (Mention/Campaign reply) don't read as visually de-emphasized vs unread ones.
[H] med | tabs (All/Mentions/Unread) | tab labels are small, low-contrast gray with only a thin underline distinguishing the active tab — no weight or fill change, weak affordance.
[H] low | per-row action labels | "Mark Read"/"Mark Unread" actions are plain low-contrast gray text at the right edge of every row, competing with the timestamp metadata in visual weight.
[C] med | right half of every row | each card is ~90% empty whitespace between the left content and the far-right action label, wasting horizontal space while the body text is truncated on the left.
[C] med | bottom of last row | card 7 ends mid-render at the window bottom with a sliver of text visible, reading as a debug overflow rather than a managed scroll viewport.
[C] low | whole list | all seven cards share one identical treatment with no grouping by day or read/unread section, flattening the list into undifferentiated noise.

VERDICT: unprofessional — truncated and clipped content, inconsistent card geometry, and dead whitespace throughout read as an unfinished prototype, not shippable product.
